title: The standard affine charts of a power of the projective line
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $n\ge1$, $\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] with structure morphism $q_1$, $X=(\mathbf P^1_S)^n=\mathbf P^1_S\times_S\cdots\times_S\mathbf P^1_S$ the $n$-fold fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $\mathrm{pr}_i:X\to\mathbf P^1_S$ and $p_n:X\to S$. Put $\mathcal L_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*\mathcal O(1)$ (an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]) and $x_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_0$, $y_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L_i)$. For $A\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}$ let $U_A=\bigcap_{i\in A}X_{y_i}\cap\bigcap_{i\notin A}X_{x_i}$, where $X_s$ is the open set where the section $s$ does not vanish. Then: (i) the $2^n$ opens $U_A$ cover $X$; (ii) for every affine open $S'=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and every $A$, the open $U_A\cap p_n^{-1}(S')$ is affine, and the $R$-algebra map $R[Z_i\,(i\in A),W_i\,(i\notin A)]\to\Gamma(U_A\cap p_n^{-1}(S'),\mathcal O)$ from the polynomial ring in $n$ variables, $Z_i\mapsto z_i=x_i/y_i$, $W_i\mapsto w_i=y_i/x_i$ (the unique functions with $x_i=z_iy_i$ on $X_{y_i}$, $y_i=w_ix_i$ on $X_{x_i}$), is an isomorphism.
